'''October 2001 Abington tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Abington, Pennsylvania on 13 October 2001. [[Greg Shaw]] won it. It is known from Greg Shaw's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3052">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-13-abington-pa-10-13-01d3052/ abington-pa-10-13-01], DeckTech (Greg "TychoCelchu" Shaw, 13 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-13-abington-pa-10-13-01d3052/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Abington, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Greg Shaw]]
